result.prior_version_note: The earlier annual allowable increases were 1.4% for March 1, 2025 – February 28, 2026 (D080, D083) and 1.7% for March 1, 2024 – February 28, 2025 (D083). D080 and D083 also point to a 'complete list' of past increases, but that list is not among the documents. The documents do not say when the Rent Ordinance's annual increase limit first took effect, so in_force_since is left unknown; the earliest documented period starts March 1, 2024.
